name: gorilla-mcp
description: Find your first 100 SaaS users by searching Reddit, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Bluesky for real demand signals.
long_description:
Model Context Protocol server for [Gorilla](https://usegorilla.app). Paste an idea and Gorilla returns scored leads from real posts across Reddit, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Bluesky where people are actively expressing demand.

## Tools

- `search` — search every source in parallel, returns scored Hot / Warm / Cold results in 30-90s
- `get_search` — fetch results for a search by its search_id (recovery / re-read)
- `billing_status` — check plan and credit balance

## Pricing

Start free: 100 credits, no card. Paid plan is $14.99/mo for 2,000 credits with rollover. You spend one credit per qualified lead (hot or warm); low-relevance results are free. LinkedIn is a paid-plan source; the free tier covers Reddit, X, YouTube, and Bluesky.

Get your API key at [usegorilla.app](https://usegorilla.app).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Reddit, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Bluesky in parallel for posts where people express demand for what you describe. Returns results ranked Hot / Warm / Cold by buying intent. One credit per qualified lead (Hot or Warm); Cold results are free; a failed search is refunded. LinkedIn is a paid-plan source; the free tier covers Reddit, X, YouTube, and Bluesky. Takes 30-90s.

query.description: What to search for, in your own words. The backend expands it into per-platform intent phrasings.

source.description: Which platform to search, or 'all' (default) for every supported source in parallel.

since.description: Time range: '24h' | '7d' | '30d' | 'all', or an ISO date. Default 7d.

tools.name: get_search
tools.description: Fetch the current state and results for a search by its search_id. Use it to recover a search that timed out client-side, or to re-read a recent one. Free.

search_id.description: The search_id returned by a prior search call.

tools.name: billing_status
tools.description: Check your plan and credit balance. Free.

api_key.title: Gorilla API Key
api_key.description: Your API key from platform.usegorilla.app (Menu → API Keys → Create). Starts with grla_. The server starts without it so you can browse tools, but every tool call requires a key.
